target: fatal accidents involving Boeing commercial jets

evidence.source_title: 2023 Annual Safety Report / 2023 Safest Year for Flying By Several Parameters
evidence.observation: IATA reports a single fatal accident in 2023, involving a turboprop aircraft with 72 fatalities, and zero fatal jet accidents or jet fatalities.
evidence.use: annual fatal-event universe and zero-jet attestation

evidence.source_title: 2024 Safety Report note on revised accident definition
evidence.observation: IATA states that in 2023 its accident definition was revised to include fatal accidents resulting in fatalities on the ground or on other aircraft, reported as Other Fatalities.

evidence.authority_role: manufacturer statistical publisher; archived public copy
evidence.source_title: 2023 Statistical Summary of Commercial Jet Airplane Accidents — Worldwide Operations 1959-2023
evidence.scope: worldwide commercial-jet fleet under Boeing definitions
evidence.observation: Boeing states that the commercial-airplane operations tracked in its 2023 Statistical Summary recorded no fatalities in 2023 and its annual accident table contains no fatal entry.
evidence.provenance_caveat: The inspected public copy is a non-Boeing host of an identified Boeing report; it is used as independent supporting evidence rather than sole provenance.

evidence.observation: EASA's broader 2023 fatal-accident universe includes non-jet/non-Boeing events; this does not conflict with IATA's explicit zero-fatal-jet result and is retained as a scope distinction rather than interpreted as a Boeing event.

completeness_assessment.reason: IATA explicitly reports zero fatal jet accidents under a methodology that, from 2023, also captures qualifying fatalities on the ground or on other aircraft. Boeing independently reports a fatality-free 2023 commercial-jet year. Therefore the fixed Boeing-commercial-jet target has zero qualifying cases in 2023 rather than merely no cases discovered.

gate_effect: 2023 annual cell PASS; overall G1 remains BLOCKED until every required annual cell passes
